💥 Full Reset

This option deletes ALL test/experiment data — students, staff, agents, attendance, fees, selfies, locations, pending registrations, membership, salary claims/slips, HRMS employees, as well as the data of the Agent, HRMS and Student Attendance portals (including Firebase). Only the Admin login and Library Settings will remain, and new registrations will start afresh.

💰 Registration Fees (Agent / HRMS / Material User / Customer)

Set the default fee for new Agent, HRMS and Material User registrations (₹0 = free — the payment gateway is skipped). Add custom fees for a specific mobile number or Agent username — a custom ₹0 makes that user / agent's registration free. Customer registration uses the membership plan price unless a custom fee is set here.

🧾 Invoice Gateway Fee (Material Portal)

This fee is charged every time a material user generates an invoice or saves an edited invoice. ₹0 = free: the payment gateway is bypassed and the invoice is generated instantly. Any other amount is charged exactly through the gateway. A user-specific amount (Invoice Material List → Edit) overrides this default.

🗄️ Backup & Data Restore
Export, verify and restore Agent Portal, HRMS, Student Portal, attendance and admin configuration data.
Ready
🔐 Protect your backup. A system backup can contain personal records and administrator data. Save it to an encrypted pen drive/external drive and do not share it publicly. Session tokens are excluded. Server-wide changes are reported separately from local browser data.

Create & Download Full Backup

Pen-drive / external-drive export

Collects managed local data plus server records available through the configured admin APIs and Firebase connection. The export includes a manifest and any read warnings.

Cloud data is included only when the current session is authorized and the related endpoint is reachable. Any unavailable source is listed in the manifest.
↥

Restore System Data

Restore from a saved JSON backup

Choose or drop an Anmol LibMatrix backup file. Review its date and record groups, then confirm before overwriting current data.

Restore validates the format and allowlists keys before writing. Existing records in matching tables may be overwritten.
⚠

Master System Factory Reset

Danger zone — permanently clears operational records

Resets Agent accounts, student profiles, staff/HRMS records, attendance, fee transactions and related operational records to empty defaults. Super Admin accounts, login/session setup, admin settings and payment/SMS configuration are retained so you do not lock yourself out. Create a backup first.

Server note: Online reset writes to configured admin-entity/blob APIs and legacy Firebase nodes. If a remote write fails, the page reports the failed table and does not claim the full reset succeeded.

Account Details

Recover account
Use your registered email or mobile number to receive a one-time verification code.
For your security, the recovery code must be sent and verified by the server. This page will not create or display OTP codes itself.

Confirm system restore

This will overwrite matching records in the selected backup.

⚠️ Make sure you have a separate backup of the current system. Unknown keys and authentication tokens will not be restored. Some server writes may fail if the API route is unavailable.

Master Factory Reset

Two-step confirmation required

This action permanently clears operational records.
Agent accounts, student/staff profiles, HRMS registrations, attendance and fee/transaction records will be set to empty defaults. Super Admin accounts, admin settings and payment/SMS configuration are retained. Take a backup first.
For safety, enter the current Super Admin password and type CONFIRM RESET. Online sessions are re-authenticated against the server before any writes are attempted.
